Hi Kenneth!

So that spike in the first chart could have been news; very over-zealous buyers. Given this is gold, it doesnt surprise me. This was probably bullish news for GOLD and it shot up taking out all of those levels above it. But those buyers towards the top were buying into supply - that top section is a key level, turning that spike into a news event FO in my opinion.

In your second chart, that is definitely a reaction to that price level around #30 - this is an FTR in fact. There was a basing that took place, then a decision to rise higher unfolded under an influx of demand. When price retests, the demand stops price from falling here - so we can reason theres a nice volume of around this area.

Regarding your second question on chart 2, you are right that price FO's to the upside before collapsing on itself - BO long traders would have sold when they didnt see the move they were after, and then we would have had traders shorting at the edge too. Then then buy back on the retrace for a scalp, but increase the demand pressure - see all of those tails in the rounded pullback. This whole abstraction in price is an FTR - a nice sign post there might well be more demand here as price accelerates away.

Notice also where this FO is, is actually were price is trying to get from one zone to the next - once it breaches into the other zone, off it goes...thats a key piece of the puzzle.

HTH

MF
